get.summary: GET health — example read-only Route Handler.

enabled.description: Master switch: promotion can appear on the landing page

startDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD start bound; null = no start limit

endDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD end bound; null = no end limit

hideAfterExpiry.description: When true (default), landing hides the section after endDate passes

showBeforeStartDate.description: When true (default), landing shows before startDate (announce early). When false, only between start and end dates
